M: The ward wall. Painted along it, every few feet: STRONGER TODAY. Under some, smaller: (than what?)
I: Long stone barracks, shutters open, full of snoring.
5: THE FURY HALL. From inside: drums, and a lot of shouting, in time.
6: THE STITCHERY. A sign on the door: WALK IT OFF. Under it: (DOCTOR'S ORDERS).
7: THE IRONHOUSE. Bunks, kit, and the quartermaster. KNOCK. FILL IN THE KNOCKING FORM FIRST.
F: The drill yard's rail. Polished smooth by forty years of leaning.
y: A training dummy. Straw and sacking, very battered.
q: A barrel of water for the drill yard. Somebody has written KALDOR'S on it in chalk, and somebody else has added 'WATER'.
c: A lantern on a post, lit. Somebody keeps it burning.
<: The way west, back to the bazaar.

objects.name: Drillmaster Ox
lines: ONE. TWO. …WHAT COMES AFTER TWO. FOUR.
Nobody's ever told him. Nobody's brave enough.

answer: THREE. THREE. ONE TWO THREE FOUR.
Forty years. FORTY YEARS. You there! Recruit! You've done more for this yard than any of 'em.

objects.name: Recruit Rolf
lines: I joined up to impress a girl.
She joined up too. She's my sergeant now. I've never been less impressive.

objects.name: Sergeant Kaya
lines: Rolf. Rolf, you're holding it upside down.
…He joined to impress me. It's working, a bit. Don't tell him.

objects.name: Gorm the Polite
lines: Sorry. Sorry, I'm going to headbutt you now. Sorry.
…Sorry, I've changed my mind. You look nice. Sorry.

objects.name: Bruni
lines: This is my pet rock. His name's Kaldor.
Not after the king. It's a coincidence. He was called Kaldor before the king was.
It's the one in front of you. It looks very pleased with itself.
